title: HarvestBatch create request
description: The body of POST /api/v1/harvest-batches, reserved by MOS-API-112 and registered in table 10.2-B row R1 against the permission harvest_batch.open. Chapter 17 owns the entity (MOS-TRAIN-078, MOS-TRAIN-083, MOS-TRAIN-202) and chapter 12 its physical form; this schema is the wire form and redefines neither. Fields are derived from the columns 0011_curation.up.sql leaves writable at insert. tenant_id is NOT a member: it is bound from the credential, and a tenant_id in a request body is the shape MOS-API-041's cross-tenant refusal exists to prevent. opened_by is NOT a member either: it is the authenticated principal, and MOS-TRAIN-080's 'named human' is worth nothing if the caller may name someone else.

capability_id.description: MOS-REG-041: lower snake_case. The capability the corpus is being harvested for.

sampling_plan_id.description: MOS-TRAIN-083: a HarvestBatch MUST declare a versioned SamplingPlan BEFORE any candidate is drawn. Required, never nullable: a nullable plan makes the rule a convention. The plan is sealed at insert (MOS-STORE-359), so this names an existing sampling_plans row and never a plan supplied inline.

training_data_policy_id.description: MOS-TRAIN-073 and MOS-TRAIN-076: the batch names the instrument it was drawn under, so a later revocation can say which candidates predate it without reconstructing the answer from timestamps. MOS-TRAIN-072 is evaluated against the tenant's training_use_allowed before this body is read; a false flag refuses 403 TRAINING_USE_NOT_PERMITTED and no batch is created.
